decision.rationale: The recent deploy changed prompt_version to v5 and metrics show a drop in citation_rate and groundedness plus judge warnings about claims not in context—pointing primarily at a prompt/regression, though index latency/errors and some performance impacts merit secondary attention.

log_snippets: chat: 429 Too Many Requests from gateway (rate limit)
judge: answer contains claims not in context

request.question: Which specialist agent should investigate this incident?
request.rubric: retrieval: chunking, top_k, embeddings, reranking quality. prompt: prompt version, citation behavior, instruction changes. index: stale content, indexer state, index schema. performance: latency, throttling, capacity, errors from dependencies. Agent health is context: prefer the right specialist even if it is slow.
